product.name: STORKLINTA
product.introText: STORKLINTA chest of 6 drawers, white, 70x50x120 cm. Assembly instructions AA-2620328-4 (simplified: the drawer interlock is left out). Tools: Phillips screwdriver, hammer.
product.partsSummary: 3x Back,  1x Bottom,  6x Dback,  6x Dbottom,  1x Divider,  8x Dowel,  24x Dscrew,  6x Dside l,  6x Dside r,  6x Front,  4x Glide,  1x Plinth,  36x Rscrew,  1x Runner div l,  1x Runner div r,  5x Runner l,  5x Runner r,  2x Side,  1x Top

steps.title: Runners on the left side
steps.text: Lay the left side panel down, inside up. Screw the 5 drawer runners on, 3 screws each, front ends to the front edge.

steps.title: Runners on the right side
steps.text: Do the same on the right side panel.

steps.title: Dowels
steps.text: Tap 2 dowels into each end of the top and the bottom panel.

steps.title: Build the frame
steps.text: Lay the right side panel on its front edge. Push the top and the bottom panel onto its dowels, put the plinth in front of the bottom and close the frame with the left side panel.

steps.title: Divider
steps.text: Put the divider between the two top drawers, under the top panel, runners facing the sides.

steps.title: Runners on the divider
steps.text: Screw one runner onto each face of the divider, 3 screws each.

steps.title: Back panels
steps.text: Slide the 3 back panels, smooth side out, into the grooves from the open (bottom) end, one after the other: the first one goes all the way to the top, where the clips hold it; the next ones follow and are joined by the dowels.

steps.title: Glides
steps.text: Press the 4 glides into the bottom edges of the side panels.

steps.title: Drawer sides
steps.text: Stand the chest up. Lay the 6 drawer fronts face down and click two drawer sides onto each front.

steps.title: Drawer bottoms
steps.text: Slide each drawer bottom into the grooves of the sides, smooth side up, all the way to the front.

steps.title: Drawer backs
steps.text: Push each back panel down between the sides, over the drawer bottom.

steps.title: Drawer screws
steps.text: Fix each back panel with 4 screws through the sides.

steps.title: Insert the drawers
steps.text: Put the drawers onto the runners and push them in. Always anchor the chest to the wall (pages 23-28) - wall fixings are not included.
